blocks.x: Precision agriculture converts sensing into input savings and yield: soil/weather/crop telemetry, variable-rate practice, agronomy models and machine orchestration. The unit economics are per-hectare — and they clear investment hurdles when engineered honestly.

The workflows we industrialize here: Variable-rate input planning, Yield/quality forecasting, Harvest logistics, Agronomy advisory, Machine fleet ops. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.
